### source page index 11

Invesco India Small Cap Fund
(An open ended equity scheme predominantly investing in small cap stocks)
Fund P/E - FY27E 37.78
Fund P/B 4.84
Fund P/E - FY27E is current price to earnings for FY26E,
Fund P/B is 12 months trailing price to book value. Both are
arrived at using Weighted Harmonic Mean which is an
average resulting from the multiplication of the reciprocal
of the observation for each component by the weightage
of that stock in the portfolio/index. For 1,2, 5 and related
disclaimer / notes, refer page no. 69.### source page index 12
